# Contributing to Not Just Note

Not Just Note is an independently maintained fork of Krita. Please open issues and pull
requests for fork-specific changes in this repository:

<https://github.com/pongkhunwuttijarat-droid/not-just-note>

When reporting a problem, include the app version, platform and OS version, device model
where relevant, steps to reproduce, and any useful logs or screenshots. For pen issues,
include the pen model and the related tablet gesture settings.

The current release candidate targets Android tablets. The source also includes Linux and
Windows desktop builds; Linux has a documented development build path, while a Not Just
Note Windows build has not yet been separately validated. Please state which platform and
build you used when contributing or reporting results.

For changes intended for upstream Krita itself, use the
[KDE Krita project](https://invent.kde.org/graphics/krita) and follow its
[coding guidelines](https://invent.kde.org/graphics/krita/-/blob/master/HACKING). Fork-
specific features and fixes should be proposed here, not sent to KDE as upstream changes.
